title: Restricted finite coefficient map pastes the two pullback unit squares
statement: For any scheme morphism f:X->Y, point y, module F, level n, resolutions I,K,J and open V, let E and D be the local and finite FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Write g for the local projection, j=formalFunctionsFiniteiota, i=formalFibreIota, U=f inverse V, Uprime=g inverse U, W=i inverse U, Fprime=g tensor-pullback F and F_n=i tensor-pullback F [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-finite-pullback]. Given hle:W subset j inverse Uprime, put r=j.resLE(Uprime,W,hle), s=g.resLE(U,Uprime), q=i.resLE(U,W). For every equality hrs:r followed by s=q and sheaf map tau:Fprime restricted to Uprime -> r_* of F_n restricted to W whose restriction-unit square equals the restriction of formalFunctionsFiniteFMap, E.psi followed by s_*tau followed by pushforwardComp(r,s) and pushforwardCongr(hrs) equals D.psi. The restriction-unit square is u_Uprime followed by b_*tau followed by pushforwardComp(r,b) and pushforwardCongr(r followed by b=a followed by j) = formalFunctionsFiniteFMap followed by j_*u_W followed by pushforwardComp(a,j), where b and a are the open inclusions. No cohomology or properness assumption occurs.

source.place: Tag 02OD proof, factorization of c_n through c; Section 01F7 and Remark 01FB, composition and restriction of coefficient h-maps. Read https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OD, /01F7 and /01FB. The restriction-unit diagram chase expands the omitted finite-neighbourhood verification.

proof.text: Write g for the local projection, j for the finite map and i for the finite projection, so j followed by g equals i. Let u_g and u_i be the units of the chosen tensor-pullback adjunctions, and phi the specified formalFunctionsFiniteFMap. Transposing the definition of phi by apply_symm_apply gives u_g followed by g_*phi = u_i followed by the equality identification i_* -> (j followed by g)_* and the inverse composition identification. Multiplying by the forward composition and equality identifications gives u_g followed by g_*phi followed by pushforwardComp(j,g) and pushforwardCongr(jg=i) = u_i.

Put U=f inverse V, Uprime=g inverse U and W=i inverse U, with inclusions c,b,a respectively, and r=j restricted W->Uprime, s=g restricted Uprime->U, q=i restricted W->U. Let M be Fprime restricted to Uprime and N be F_n restricted to W. Define the comparison isomorphisms A: s_* followed by c_* -> b_* followed by g_*, B: r_* followed by b_* -> a_* followed by j_*, C: q_* followed by c_* -> a_* followed by i_* by pushforwardComp, the resLE_comp_iota equality, and inverse pushforwardComp. Cancel the last composition isomorphism from E.unit_square, the assumed restriction square of tau, and D.unit_square. The resulting equations are u_U followed by c_*E.psi followed by A_M = u_g followed by g_*u_Uprime; u_Uprime followed by b_*tau followed by B_N = phi followed by j_*u_W; and u_U followed by c_*D.psi followed by C_N = u_i followed by i_*u_W.

Let Q=pushforwardComp(r,s)_N followed by pushforwardCongr(hrs)_N. The coherence identity is c_*Q followed by C_N = A_(r_*N) followed by g_*B_N followed by pushforwardComp(j,g)_(a_*N) followed by pushforwardCongr(jg=i)_(a_*N). Check it on each open T of X: every pushforwardComp component is the identity, and each pushforwardCongr component is the presheaf restriction for the equality of inverse-image opens. Both composites are the same restriction from r inverse (s inverse (c inverse T)) to a inverse (i inverse T). The presheaf map-composition law and proof irrelevance identify them. Naturality of A in tau then gives u_U followed by c_*(E.psi followed by s_*tau followed by Q) followed by C_N = u_g followed by g_*(u_Uprime followed by b_*tau followed by B_N) followed by the global composition and equality identifications.

Insert the tau-square from the preceding step. Naturality of pushforwardComp(j,g) followed by pushforwardCongr(jg=i) in u_W moves that restriction unit to the last factor. The global unit identity of step 1 turns the remaining initial composite into u_i. The resulting map is u_i followed by i_*u_W, which is the transpose of D.psi followed by C_N by step 2. Cancel the invertible C_N and use injectivity of the restriction adjunction homEquiv for U to conclude E.psi followed by s_*tau followed by Q = D.psi. This is only a coefficient sheaf-map identity: there is no cohomology degree, global class, or existential additive map in the statement. Zero coefficients and empty opens make all components zero; none of the steps assumes V contains y.

lean.statement:
theorem formalFunctions_finite_open_unit_pasting {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (y : Y) (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (K : InjectiveResolution
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F))
    (V : Y.Opens)
    (E : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f (Y.fromSpecStalk y) F I K V)
    (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f (formalFibreBaseMap Y y n) F I J V) :
    let g := pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f
    let j := formalFunctionsFiniteι f y n
    let i := formalFibreι f y n
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let U' := g ⁻¹ᵁ U
    let W := i ⁻¹ᵁ U
    let F' := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj F
    let Fₙ := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj F
    ∀ (hle : W ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ U'),
      let r := j.resLE U' W hle
      let s := g.resLE U U' le_rfl
      let q := i.resLE U W le_rfl
      ∀ (hrs : r ≫ s = q)
        (τ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U'.ι).obj F' ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj Fₙ)),
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U'.ι).unit.app F' ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U'.ι).map τ ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r U'.ι).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj Fₙ) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (j.resLE_comp_ι hle)).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj Fₙ) =
        formalFunctionsFiniteFMap f y F n ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction W.ι).unit.app Fₙ) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp W.ι j).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj Fₙ) →
        E.psi ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).map τ ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r s).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj Fₙ) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hrs).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj Fₙ) = D.psi
